payload.reason: The evidence provides specific correlations between different variants of ROUGE scores and their effectiveness in evaluating scientific summarization, indicating that different variants yield different correlation values with human judgments.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in different correlation values with human judgments, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
Rouge-2 and Rouge-3 are better correlated with manual judgments in the context of scientific summarization compared to other variants.
Rouge-1 and Rouge-L show weak correlations with human pyramid scores, while higher-order n-grams like Rouge-3 correlate better.
The effectiveness of ROUGE for scientific summarization is challenged by weak correlations with semi-manual evaluation scores like Pyramid.
